blueprint.summary: List building and enrichment that chains data providers and AI steps in one table. Credits climb with wide waterfalls, so table design decides cost.
use_when: You need to enrich a list from several providers
You want AI steps on each row
avoid_when: One provider covers the fields you need

setup.do: Connect your own provider keys where you have them; this removes that provider's data credit cost.
Check the plan before relying on HTTP API, webhooks or CRM sync: they start on Growth.

steps.do: Import records and run the cheapest provider first.
Gate each later step with a condition so it runs only on rows still missing the field.
gotchas: Unconditioned waterfall steps run on every row

steps.do: Run AI steps last, on the rows that passed the earlier filters.

pitfalls.fix: Order providers cheapest first and stop once a field is found

pitfalls.issue: Every enrichment still uses one Action even with your own key
pitfalls.fix: Filter rows before enrichment, not after

quality_bar: Later steps conditioned on earlier results

limits.note: Cannot be topped up one-off and do not roll over
